data.title: Design & Build Package

$media.alt: Design and Build turnkey construction site

data.excerpt: Single-source accountability uniting architectural design, structural engineering, permitting, and turnkey construction under one guaranteed contract.

children.text: We get involved at the earliest concept stage so architectural vision, structural engineering, and real-world construction costs stay aligned from day one. By combining design and field execution under a single contract, owners eliminate finger-pointing between separate consultants and shave up to 22% off total project delivery schedules.
What Is Included in Our Turnkey Package

Every Design & Build engagement starts with site feasibility, geotechnical investigation, and 3D BIM coordination before a single shovel hits the ground. Our integrated team manages municipal permitting, value engineering, long-lead material procurement, and full-time site supervision.
Early Cost Certainty & Zero Change-Order Surprises

Traditional design-bid-build workflows often expose budget overruns only after architectural drawings are 100% finished. Our continuous cost-modeling locks in a Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) at the 60% design milestone, protecting your capital plan while preserving architectural quality.
Key Deliverables
Clients receive full architectural & structural blueprints, clash-free MEP models, weekly earned-value progress reports, commissioning documentation, and an as-built digital twin upon handover.

data.title: Building Renovation

$media.alt: Modern commercial and residential building renovation

data.excerpt: Structural retrofits, facade modernization, seismic upgrades, and luxury interior transformations for occupied and heritage buildings.

children.text: Modernizing an existing structure demands surgical precision. Whether breathing new life into a century-old masonry landmark or upgrading a commercial tower to LEED Gold energy performance, our renovation division protects structural integrity while minimizing disruption to surrounding tenants.
Structural Retrofit & Envelope Modernization

Before demolition begins, we perform laser point-cloud scanning and non-destructive slab radar testing to uncover hidden utilities and load paths. Our crews specialize in steel reinforcement, curtain-wall replacement, acoustic isolation, and high-efficiency HVAC/MEP retrofits.
Phased Execution in Occupied Facilities

For hospitals, offices, and retail spaces that cannot afford downtime, we engineer negative-pressure dust containment zones, off-hours noisy work windows, and strict safety barricades so daily operations continue seamlessly.

data.title: Project Management

$media.alt: Construction project managers reviewing blueprints on site

data.excerpt: End-to-end owner's representation, critical-path scheduling, subcontractor procurement, and rigorous QA/QC safety governance.

children.text: We seek to get involved early in the planning phase so we can structure procurement packages, pre-qualify tier-one trade partners, and mitigate supply-chain bottlenecks long before mobilization.
Critical-Path Control & Earned-Value Reporting
Using Primavera P6 and cloud field-tracking, our Project Directors monitor daily crew productivity, concrete pour cycles, RFI turnaround times, and cash-flow drawdowns against baseline milestones.
Zero-Incident Safety Culture

Every jobsite operates under daily toolbox briefings, digital permit-to-work checklists, and independent third-party safety audits—maintaining an Experience Modification Rate (EMR) well below industry averages.

data.title: Construction Consulting

$media.alt: Pre-construction engineering and feasibility consulting

data.excerpt: Feasibility studies, independent quantity surveying, value engineering, constructability reviews, and distressed-project recovery.

children.text: Understanding manpower, constructability, and cash-flow dynamics determines the success or failure of capital projects before contracts are signed. Our senior estimators and licensed engineers act as your independent technical shield.
Constructability & Value Engineering Audits

We audit third-party architectural and structural packages line by line to eliminate redundant tolerances, over-specified assemblies, and sequence clashes—routinely unlocking 8% to 15% in hard-cost savings without sacrificing aesthetics or durability.

data.title: Architecture & Sustainable Design

$media.alt: Contemporary architectural facade and spatial modeling

data.excerpt: Climate-responsive architecture, 5D BIM coordination, passive solar daylighting, and net-zero commercial & residential design.

children.text: Great architecture balances human proportion, natural daylight, and structural honesty. Our studio pairs award-winning spatial design with practical field buildability so bold concepts translate effortlessly to steel, timber, and architectural concrete.
BIM-Driven Design & Energy Modeling

Every elevation and floorplate is simulated for solar heat gain, cross-ventilation, acoustic comfort, and lifecycle maintenance—lowering operational energy bills by up to 38% over conventional code baselines.

data.title: Concrete & Structural Works

$media.alt: Heavy structural concrete foundations and post-tensioned slabs

data.excerpt: Deep foundations, post-tensioned slabs, architectural exposed concrete, structural steel erection, and high-volume batch logistics.

children.text: From mat foundations and subterranean retaining walls to long-span post-tensioned podiums, our self-performing structural crews deliver tight laser-screed flatness tolerances and certified compressive strength on every pour.
Precision Batching, Pumping & Curing

Real-time thermal maturity sensors embedded inside concrete pours let our engineers verify strength gain accurately, accelerating formwork stripping safely while preventing shrinkage cracking in extreme climates.

data.title: Green House

$media.alt: Green House sustainable residence in Mountain View

data.excerpt: Net-zero passive residence featuring triple-glazed curtain walls, cross-laminated timber framing, and high-R acoustic/thermal isolation.

children.text: Commissioned by Hung Group in Mountain View, Green House demonstrates how residential architecture can achieve net-positive energy performance without compromising expansive indoor-outdoor California living.
Project Challenge

The client requested floor-to-ceiling southwest glass views facing a mature oak canopy while maintaining whisper-quiet interior acoustics (<28 dBA) and near-zero HVAC load during peak summer heatwaves.
Engineering & Construction Solution

Our team engineered a thermally broken steel-and-timber hybrid frame wrapped in continuous mineral-wool exterior isolation, paired with motorized architectural louvers, radiant hydronic limestone floors, and a 24 kW integrated solar roof.
Delivered Outcome
Handed over 3 weeks ahead of schedule with zero lost-time safety incidents, achieving LEED Platinum certification and reducing annual grid energy demand by 94%.

data.title: Pool In Luxury Neighbourhood

$media.alt: Cantilevered infinity pool and luxury villa pavilion

data.excerpt: Cantilevered infinity-edge lap pool, sunken outdoor lounge pavilion, and automated saltwater hydronic plumbing on a sloped hillside estate.

children.text: Perched along a 28-degree hillside grade, this luxury residential compound required deep caisson foundations, crystalline waterproof shotcrete, and seamless architectural travertine decks.
Hydraulic & Structural Highlights

Working alongside architects Jason & Perry, Structure installed 14 reinforced concrete micro-piles tied into a post-tensioned grade beam, supporting a 22-meter zero-edge basin with whisper-quiet variable-speed filtration and solar-assisted water heating.

data.title: House of Cards

$media.alt: House of Cards geometric commercial headquarters in Barcelona

data.excerpt: Multi-tiered cantilevered concrete and porcelain-clad mixed-use complex engineered for coastal wind loads and Mediterranean solar control.

children.text: House of Cards takes its name from its dramatic interlocking cantilevered floorplates that create self-shading terraces across six commercial levels in Barcelona's innovation district.
Precision Formwork & Large-Format Tiling

Over 18,000 square meters of ventilated large-format sintered stone tiling and concealed rainwater drainage plumbing were installed to laser-guided tolerances, delivering a crisp geometric silhouette that stays cool year-round.

data.title: Green School

$media.alt: Green School daylight-filled educational campus

data.excerpt: Daylight-optimized STEM educational campus featuring acoustic classroom isolation, greywater harvesting, and non-toxic interior finishes.

children.text: Designed to nurture student concentration and healthy indoor air quality, Green School integrates clerestory daylighting, acoustic timber baffles, and 100% rainwater-fed landscape irrigation.
Fast-Track Summer Window Execution
To avoid disrupting the academic calendar, pre-fabricated wall panels and modular MEP racks were assembled off-site and craned into position within a strict 14-week structural window.

data.title: House Under The Palms

$media.alt: House Under The Palms coastal villa

data.excerpt: Coastal Mediterranean residence combining marine-grade concrete durability, breathable thermal render, and handcrafted artisan stone tiling.

children.text: Exposed to salt-laden coastal breezes, House Under The Palms was built with sulfate-resistant concrete, duplex stainless-steel fixings, and seamless indoor-to-terrace basalt stone tiling.
Craftsmanship & Microclimate Comfort
Deep overhanging eaves and cross-ventilated courtyards keep interior living spaces naturally cool, cutting mechanical air-conditioning runtime in half.

data.title: Contemporary Villa

$media.alt: Contemporary Villa architectural concrete and glass facade

data.excerpt: Board-formed architectural concrete villa with a column-free 14-meter glass living pavilion and custom book-matched marble interiors.

children.text: Understanding manpower, sequencing, and cash-flow discipline determined the flawless execution of Contemporary Villa. Every architectural concrete reveal was mocked up full-scale prior to final pouring.
Column-Free Structural Engineering
A concealed post-tensioned transfer beam spans 14 meters over the main living gallery, allowing motorized glass walls to pocket completely out of sight.

data.title: Kitchen And Living Room

$media.alt: Bespoke open-concept penthouse kitchen and living room remodel

data.excerpt: Open-concept penthouse interior gut-renovation featuring monolithic quartzite islands, concealed linear HVAC diffusers, and Italian porcelain slabs.

children.text: Transforming a compartmentalized apartment into a gallery-grade open living space required removing two load-bearing masonry partitions and threading flush structural steel headers inside the ceiling plenum.
Millwork & Stone Precision
Custom smoked-oak cabinetry, acoustic floating subfloors, and continuous vein-matched porcelain tiling create an effortless flow between culinary entertaining and lounge zones.

data.title: Villa Rustica Renovation

$media.alt: Villa Rustica heritage masonry and plumbing modernization

data.excerpt: Complete structural stabilization, radiant underfloor plumbing, and historic stone restoration of a countryside estate.

children.text: Preserving original hand-dressed stone arches while bringing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing infrastructure up to modern boutique-hospitality standards was the centerpiece of Villa Rustica.
Hidden Modern Infrastructure
All copper manifold plumbing, heat-pump chillers, and smart lighting conduits were routed beneath breathable lime-mortar screeds—leaving 19th-century stonework untouched and authentic.

data.title: Female Engineers – Winning with the Velvet Glove

$media.alt: Construction engineer inspecting structural steel on site

data.excerpt: Why collaborative jobsite leadership, clear technical communication, and calm conflict resolution consistently outperform table-pounding on complex builds.

children.text: Industry journals have published plenty of statistics on representation in civil and structural engineering. What deserves far more attention is how collaborative leadership styles measurably improve schedule reliability on high-pressure construction sites.
Clarity Beats Confrontation in Field Coordination

On a multi-trade jobsite with 180 subcontractors competing for crane hooks and hoist windows, aggressive confrontation slows information flow. Subcontractors hide emerging issues when they expect blame. By contrast, structured daily huddles grounded in mutual respect surface field tolerances 48 hours earlier—when fixes cost hundreds of dollars instead of tens of thousands.
Building High-Trust Engineering Teams
Contractors that pair rigorous QA/QC standards with calm, transparent problem-solving retain top superintendents longer and win repeat negotiated work from institutional owners.

data.title: This Century-Old Church Is Now a Cozy Home

$media.alt: Adaptive reuse transformation of a historic masonry church

data.excerpt: Adaptive reuse lessons from converting soaring vaulted timber trusses and historic stained-glass masonry into an energy-efficient modern residence.

children.text: Updating a historic building always brings hidden surprises behind every masonry pier. Converting a century-old sanctuary that was never designed for residential comfort requires balancing preservation rules with modern thermal and acoustic engineering.
Insulating Soaring Volumes Without Losing Character

To keep the original exposed hammer-beam timber trusses visible inside, the construction team installed nail-base polyisocyanurate insulation above the roof deck and zoned radiant hydronic heating across the ground floor—keeping warmth exactly where occupants live rather than heating 11-meter ceiling peaks.

data.title: 8 Paint Colors That Will Make You Rethink White

$media.alt: Warm architectural mineral wall finishes in natural daylight

data.excerpt: How subtle limestone, warm greige, and mineral sage undertones outperform stark gallery white under changing daylight orientations.

children.text: A crisp white room looks effortless in photographs, yet stark titanium white can turn cold and clinical in north-facing spaces. Architectural colorists increasingly specify nuanced mineral neutrals with Light Reflectance Values (LRV) between 62 and 78.
Testing Undertones Against Natural Orientation

Always sample large 60x60 cm primed boards across morning, midday, and warm 2700K evening LED lighting before committing to whole-floor spray application. Warm travertine, pale eucalyptus, and muted putty soften sharp drywall shadow lines while making oak millwork glow.

data.title: How To Decorate With Black-and-White

$media.alt: Monochrome architectural interior with matte black steel framing

data.excerpt: Timeless monochrome interiors rely on tactile material contrast—pairing honed stone, blackened steel mullions, and warm natural timber.

children.text: The classic black-and-white palette brings architectural discipline to lobbies, kitchens, and executive suites alike. The secret to keeping monochrome spaces inviting rather than sterile lies in texture.
Layering Matte Finishes & Natural Grain
Combine matte powder-coated steel glazing bars, honed Carrara marble, unlacquered brass hardware, and bouclé or rift-cut oak accents so light scatters softly across every surface.

data.title: What Makes Engineering Consulting Different

$media.alt: Engineering consultants reviewing structural calculations and BIM models

data.excerpt: Inside the fast-paced world of pre-construction consulting: translating owner business cases into buildable, bankable engineering specs.

children.text: Stepping into engineering consulting reveals how many pivotal project decisions happen months before a crane arrives on site. Every soil report assumption, structural grid spacing, and facade U-value ripples across millions of dollars in downstream trade bids.
Bridging Financial Models and Field Physics

Great consultants speak two languages fluently: finite-element structural mechanics for design teams, and internal rate of return (IRR), schedule contingency, and lifecycle OPEX for investment committees.

data.title: 11 Times Reclaimed Timber & Fixtures Gained New Life

$media.alt: Reclaimed architectural timber joinery in a modern commercial interior

data.excerpt: Circular construction practices that salvage heart-pine beams, industrial cast iron, and bespoke joinery for LEED credits and unmistakable character.

children.text: Demolition waste accounts for a massive share of landfill volume, yet seasoned heartwood beams and vintage architectural hardware possess density and patina that newly milled lumber cannot replicate.
Deconstruction vs. Demolition

By scheduling selective deconstruction during week one of a renovation, contractors salvage structural timber for reception desks, acoustic wall slats, and bespoke conference tables—earning LEED Materials & Resources points while telling the site's authentic story.

data.title: 4 Biophilic Color Schemes for Modern Workspaces & Homes

$media.alt: Bright biophilic interior palette with terracotta and sage tones

data.excerpt: Four architect-approved palettes inspired by terracotta clay, coastal limestone, olive foliage, and brushed bronze.

children.text: Biophilic color palettes reduce visual fatigue and anchor modern glass-and-concrete interiors in nature. Whether refreshing a boutique office or staging a model residence, pairing muted botanical greens with warm mineral clays creates immediate calm.
Balancing Accent Saturation: The 60-30-10 Rule

Anchor 60% of wall and ceiling planes in a breathable warm neutral, dedicate 30% to natural timber or stone flooring, and reserve 10% for rich terracotta, deep navy, or brushed brass architectural accents.

data.title: How Structural Engineers Look at Everyday Buildings

$media.alt: Architectural steel bridge and glass atrium structure

data.excerpt: Walk into any airport terminal or historic cathedral with a structural engineer and you'll never look at columns, cantilevers, or expansion joints the same way again.

children.text: Spend ten minutes walking through a new building alongside a structural engineer and you will quickly notice their eyes drift straight past the decorative chandeliers toward the ceiling connections, expansion joints, and lateral bracing.
Reading Load Paths in Plain Sight

Every building is a frozen diagram of gravity and wind forces finding their way safely into the earth. Appreciating how slender steel diagrids, post-tensioned slabs, and seismic dampers quietly protect occupants makes great architecture twice as inspiring.

data.title: Frequently Asked Questions
data.subtitle: Answers on Contracting Models, Timelines, Permits & Warranties

children.text: How accurate is your online Construction Cost Calculator?

Our interactive calculator uses current regional material and labor unit rates to give you an instant ballpark range (+/-12–15%) in 30 seconds. Once you share drawings or site coordinates, our pre-construction team refines it into an itemized GMP schedule within 5 business days.
Do you handle municipal building permits and inspections?

Yes. Under our Design & Build and General Contracting packages, we prepare all stamped architectural/structural submissions, coordinate fire and environmental approvals, and host all municipal inspector sign-offs.
How do you prevent budget overruns mid-project?
We perform 3D BIM clash detection and destructive investigative openings (for renovations) prior to locking our Guaranteed Maximum Price, eliminating surprise field conflicts.
Can we customize all site content and branding in EmDash Admin?
Absolutely. Every project, service, blog post, testimonial, navigation menu, and company page is managed live in EmDash CMS at /_emdash/admin.
